import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()

    # Preserve original row order
    orders = orders.reset_index(drop=True)
    orders["_orig_order"] = orders.index

    # Deduplicate reference tables on key, keeping first occurrence
    ref_customers = ref_customers.drop_duplicates(subset=["customer_id"], keep="first")
    ref_skus = ref_skus.drop_duplicates(subset=["sku"], keep="first")

    # Merge customer info
    merged = orders.merge(
        ref_customers[["customer_id", "status"]],
        on="customer_id",
        how="left",
        indicator="_cust_match",
    )

    # Merge sku info
    merged = merged.merge(
        ref_skus[["sku", "discontinued", "allowed_countries"]],
        on="sku",
        how="left",
        indicator="_sku_match",
    )

    def evaluate(row):
        # R1: customer unknown
        if row["_cust_match"] != "both":
            return "CUST_UNKNOWN"

        # R2: customer inactive
        status = row["status"]
        if pd.isna(status) or status != "ACTIVE":
            return "CUST_INACTIVE"

        # R3: sku unknown
        if row["_sku_match"] != "both":
            return "SKU_UNKNOWN"

        # R4: sku discontinued
        disc = row["discontinued"]
        try:
            disc_val = int(disc) if not pd.isna(disc) else 0
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            disc_val = 0
        if disc_val == 1:
            return "SKU_DISC"

        # R5: allowed countries whitelist
        allowed = row["allowed_countries"]
        if pd.isna(allowed):
            allowed_str = ""
        else:
            allowed_str = str(allowed)

        if allowed_str.strip() != "":
            members = [m.strip() for m in allowed_str.split(",")]
            members = [m for m in members if m != ""]
            ship_country = row["ship_country"]
            if pd.isna(ship_country) or ship_country not in members:
                return "CTRY_BLOCKED"

        return None

    merged["_reason_code"] = merged.apply(evaluate, axis=1)

    orig_cols = list(orders.columns)
    orig_cols = [c for c in orig_cols if c != "_orig_order"]

    clean_mask = merged["_reason_code"].isna()
    rejects_mask = ~clean_mask

    orders_clean = merged.loc[clean_mask, orig_cols + ["_orig_order"]].copy()
    orders_clean = orders_clean.sort_values("_orig_order").drop(columns=["_orig_order"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    orders_rejects = merged.loc[rejects_mask, orig_cols + ["_reason_code", "_orig_order"]].copy()
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects.rename(columns={"_reason_code": "reason_code"})
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects.sort_values("_orig_order").drop(columns=["_orig_order"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean,
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects,
    }
